semiconductor_relevance: High — the company focuses on testing technologies essential for integrated circuits used in IoT and autonomous driving systems.
summary: Computer System Lab at Ehime University specializes in research and development of testing technologies for integrated circuits, particularly in the context of high reliability for IoT and autonomous driving applications. Their work includes non-destructive testing methods to identify defects in integrated circuits, ensuring the safety and reliability of high-density electronic components.
